title: Audio files are optional; placeholders are labelled, never presented as the soundtrack
intent: Never depend on files that do not exist, and make it obvious when the music is a placeholder

evidence.description: only the favicon 404s; no audio file is requested that does not exist

constraints.statement: Audio files are found at build time by import.meta.glob in src/audio/assets.ts; nothing is requested that is not in the repo
Music files are used only as a complete set of six stems of identical length; otherwise all six are placeholders, and the registry key musicSource says which
A file in src/assets/audio/sfx named after an effect key replaces its recipe; createSfx skips keys already loaded
Only original or licensed audio; no Hotline Miami or other commercial soundtrack

consequences.statement: No finished soundtrack exists; placeholder stems play until all six files are in src/assets/audio/music

result.summary: all textures and sounds are generated in code; no audio or image files in the repo
